options.name: address
options.description: The IPv4 address to assign to the interface. Should be specified in xx.xx.xx.xx form. Mutually exclusive with I(config_method=dhcp)

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API. Example https://prod-1.wahoo.acme.com/devmgr/v2

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: channel
options.description: The port to modify the configuration for. The channel represents the port number (typically from left to right on the controller), beginning with a value of 1. Mutually exclusive with I(name).

options.name: config_method
options.description: The configuration method type to use for network interface ports. dhcp is mutually exclusive with I(address), I(subnet_mask), and I(gateway).

options.name: controller
options.description: The controller that owns the port you want to configure. Controller names are represented alphabetically, with the first controller as A, the second as B, and so on. Current hardware models have either 1 or 2 available controllers, but that is not a guaranteed hard limitation and could change in the future.

options.name: dns_address
options.description: Primary IPv4 DNS server address

options.name: dns_address_backup
options.description: Backup IPv4 DNS server address Queried when primary DNS server fails

options.name: dns_config_method
options.description: The configuration method type to use for DNS services. dhcp is mutually exclusive with I(dns_address), and I(dns_address_backup).

options.name: gateway
options.description: The IPv4 gateway address to utilize for the interface. Should be specified in xx.xx.xx.xx form. Mutually exclusive with I(config_method=dhcp)

options.name: log_path
options.description: A local path to a file to be used for debug logging

options.name: name
options.description: The port to modify the configuration for. The list of choices is not necessarily comprehensive. It depends on the number of ports that are present in the system. The name represents the port number (typically from left to right on the controller), beginning with a value of 1. Mutually exclusive with I(channel).

options.name: ntp_address
options.description: Primary IPv4 NTP server address

options.name: ntp_address_backup
options.description: Backup IPv4 NTP server address Queried when primary NTP server fails

options.name: ntp_config_method
options.description: The configuration method type to use for NTP services. disable is mutually exclusive with I(ntp_address) and I(ntp_address_backup). dhcp is mutually exclusive with I(ntp_address) and I(ntp_address_backup).

options.name: ssh
options.description: Enable ssh access to the controller for debug purposes. This is a controller-level setting. rlogin/telnet will be enabled for ancient equipment where ssh is not available.

options.name: ssid
options.description: The ID of the array to manage. This value must be unique for each array.

options.name: state
options.description: Enable or disable IPv4 network interface configuration. Either IPv4 or IPv6 must be enabled otherwise error will occur. Only required when enabling or disabling IPv4 network interface

options.name: subnet_mask
options.description: The subnet mask to utilize for the interface. Should be specified in xx.xx.xx.xx form. Mutually exclusive with I(config_method=dhcp)

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Should https certificates be validated?
